content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Tony Russell's PostTony Russell Verified accountJuly 29, 2025 · Shared with PublicYes, that’s Adam Sandler’s beautiful family in #happygilmore2!Sandler Family Roles: • Sunny Sandler plays Vienna Gilmore, Happy Gilmore’s daughter who is studying ballet and drives the emotional arc of the film. • Sadie Sandler portrays Charlotte, a member of Hal L.’s support group who plays a meaningful role in Happy’s journey to sobriety. • Jackie Sandler appears as Monica, Vienna’s ballet instructor who mentors and supports her—adding a nurturing presence in the story.Sandler also seems to put his close friends in his movies as often as possible.All reactions:11K154 comments170 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Katie RoseI love so much that he always includes his wife & daughters in his movies!! But this is the first time one of his daughters was his daughter, they’re usually always someone else’s kidsWhen his daughter in AA said “you remind me of my dad” I died 37w73Tony Russell replied · 7 RepliesCate BrownI think Adam has a beautiful wife and family. He is obviously very proud of them. In my personal opinion tho, both daughters did not appear natural with their acting. Im not sure if they are choosing acting as their career or if it was something mom n dad wanted them to do. I would hope that they find their true talents and passions so Mom and Dad can continue to be proud of them even if it dosent follow in their footsteps.
